purpose: FR-49 (protocol fr49-compartment-compositions-v1): code-blind closed forms for World L (a labelled pulse carried into a compartment and cleared there), World B (ligand binding with depletion in a compartment), and the combination checks C1 (labels at a washed well) and C2 (two ligands sharing one site pool in a compartment). Declared values and protocol only: no engine value is in this file.

units.share: dimensionless fraction of a species' amount at a node

L.description: LAWS.md section 2. Owner O and compartment C; S produced in O at P, carried O <-> C by the route of conductance a, cleared in C at k_d; production during [t1, t2) is labelled x

B.description: LAWS.md section 3. Ligand L in compartment C, binding finite sites of capacity S that face C; binding is L's only mover in C

wash_elsewhere.note: it changes only the well; C's equations are unaffected (LAWS.md section 3)

C1.description: LAWS.md section 4. World L, plus a well W holding S with no route across its surface, washed once

wash.buffer_label: base, although the wash falls inside world L's labelled pulse [600, 1200) s

C2.description: LAWS.md section 5. Two ligands L1 and L2 in C competing for one site pool of capacity S; binding is their only mover

requested_outputs.L: at every sample time: n_O, n_C, x_O, x_C, the base amounts n - x, and the shares x/n at O and C
requested_outputs.B: at every sample time: B, n_L and c; once: S, K_d, b, c*, B*, B1, B2 and lambda
requested_outputs.C1: x_W and b_W just before and just after the wash, and the shares there; world L's quantities as in L
requested_outputs.C2: at every sample time: B1, B2, c1, c2 and R; once: the equilibrium c1*, c2*, B1*, B2*
requested_outputs.format: one JSON file per world, results/<world>.json, every number as a decimal string of at least 20 significant digits, plus method and provenance
